probe-l2df-parser.py.text:
"""Candidate-only LF2 DAT conversion/parse probe for NTSD resource feasibility.
Uses pinned L2DF Lua source under Lupa Lua 5.1 on macOS arm64. Reads three
original resource files; never executes original EXE/DLL, game code or device APIs.
Synthetic repeat handling is compared to the already documented NTSD contract.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,platform,sys,traceback
import lupa
from lupa.lua51 import LuaRuntime,lua_type
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE=ROOT/'sources/atom-tm__l2df-engine__wip-test'
BASE=Path.cwd()/'downloads/NTSD_2.4_2.0a_clean/NTSD 2.4_2.0a'
lua=LuaRuntime(encoding=None,unpack_returned_tuples=True)
lua.globals()[b'researchPath']=str(SOURCE).encode()
lua.execute(b"package.path = researchPath .. '/?.lua;' .. researchPath .. '/?/init.lua;' .. package.path; l2df = require 'src.core'")
converter=lua.eval(b"require('tools.lf2dat')")
parser=lua.eval(b"require('src.class.parser.lffs2'):new()")

def data(value,depth=0):
 if lua_type(value)=='table':
  if depth>5:return '<depth-boundary>'
  return {str(k.decode(errors='replace') if isinstance(k,bytes) else k):data(v,depth+1) for k,v in value.items()}
 if isinstance(value,bytes):return value.decode('utf8',errors='replace')
 return value

def guard():lua.execute(b"_researchCount = 0; debug.sethook(function() _researchCount = _researchCount + 1; if _researchCount > 5000 then error('research instruction limit') end end, '', 10000)")

first=b'<frame> 0 first\n pic: 1 wait: 3 next: 0\n<frame_end>\n'
second=b'<frame> 0 second\n pic: 2\n<frame_end>\n'
inputs=[('single-frame',first,False,0,None),('duplicate-frame',first+second,False,0,None)]
for rel,kind in [('chars/naruto.dat',0),('chars/sasuke.dat',0),('chars/weapon4.dat',1)]:
 p=BASE/rel;inputs.append((p.stem,p.read_bytes(),True,kind,rel))

results=[]
for name,raw,encrypted,kind,rel in inputs:
 result={'name':name,'inputPath':rel,'encrypted':encrypted,'inputBytes':len(raw),'inputSHA256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
 try:
  guard()
  text=converter[b'decrypt'](raw) if encrypted else raw
  converted=converter[b'convert_text'](text,lua.table_from({b'type':kind}))
  output=ROOT/'probes'/name;output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  (output/'input.bin').write_bytes(raw);(output/'decrypted.txt').write_bytes(text);(output/'converted.dat').write_bytes(converted)
  result.update(decryptedBytes=len(text),decryptedSHA256=hashlib.sha256(text).hexdigest(),convertedBytes=len(converted),convertedSHA256=hashlib.sha256(converted).hexdigest(),convertedFrameStarts=converted.count(b'<frame>'))
  parsed=parser[b'parse'](parser,converted)
  frames=parsed[b'frames']; items=[frames[i] for i in range(1,len(frames)+1)] if frames is not None else []
  result.update(status='parsed',parsedName=data(parsed[b'name']),parsedFrameCount=len(items),selectedFrames=[data(f) for f in items if f[1] in [0,48,49]])
 except Exception as e: result.update(status='error',error=str(e),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
 finally:lua.execute(b'debug.sethook()')
 if rel:assert hashlib.sha256((BASE/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==result['inputSHA256']
 results.append(result)
 print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['selectedFrames','traceback']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
result={'candidate':'atom-tm/l2df-engine','branch':'wip-test','commit':'a20a16f2e8c9e889e33b3d762c94dc49498d0f83','capturedAtUTC':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'environment':{'host':platform.platform(),'python':sys.version,'lupa':lupa.__version__,'lua':lua.lua_implementation.decode() if isinstance(lua.lua_implementation,bytes) else lua.lua_implementation,'backend':data(lua.globals()[b'l2df'][b'api'][b'BACKEND'])},'originalExecuted':False,'nativeCompared':False,'gameStarted':False,'assetRenderingVerified':False,'scope':'Candidate decrypt, convert_text and LFFS2 parse only; no image/audio/device checks or full Object instantiation. Lua 5.1, not LuaJIT/LÖVE.','cases':results}
(ROOT/'l2df-parser-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')

assemble_evidence.py.text:
"""Assemble a source-only LF2 alternatives report; verify preserved inputs.

Reads pinned public-source snapshots and completed parser diagnostics. Does not
execute any original artifact or candidate parser, change old expected data, or
touch native implementation. Acceptance is for this research report only.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import re
from collections import Counter

ROOT = Path.cwd()
STUDY = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPORT = ROOT / 'docs/research/LF2_OPEN_SOURCE_ENGINES.md'
OUTPUT = ROOT / 'docs/evidence/lf2-open-source-engines.json'


def read(name):
    return json.loads((STUDY / name).read_text())


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def pin(path):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': digest(raw)}


packet = read('packet.json')
protected = []
concurrent_changes = []
for path, expected in packet['protectedFiles'].items():
    actual = pin(ROOT / path)
    unchanged = actual['bytes'] == expected['size'] and actual['sha256'] == expected['sha256']
    item = {'path': path, 'atStart': expected, 'atAudit': actual, 'unchanged': unchanged}
    protected.append(item)
    if not unchanged:
        concurrent_changes.append(item)

repositories = []
for path in sorted((STUDY / 'api').glob('*__summary.json')):
    obj = json.loads(path.read_text())
    repositories.append({
        'publisher': obj['full_name'].split('/')[0],
        'repository': obj['full_name'], 'url': obj['html_url'],
        'branch': obj['default_branch'], 'commit': obj['sha'],
        'commitURL': obj['html_url'] + '/commit/' + obj['sha'],
        'commitDateUTC': obj['lastCommit']['committer']['date'],
        'archived': obj['archived'], 'treeEntries': obj['treeEntries'],
        'treeTruncated': obj['treeTruncated'],
        'licenseAPI': obj['license']['spdx_id'] if obj['license'] else None,
    })

branches = []
for path in sorted((STUDY / 'api').glob('*__branch-summary.json')):
    obj = json.loads(path.read_text())
    branch = path.name.split('__')[2]
    branches.append({'repository': obj['full_name'], 'branch': branch,
                     'commit': obj['sha'],
                     'commitDateUTC': obj['lastCommit']['committer']['date']})

default_commits = {r['repository']: r['commit'] for r in repositories}
extra_commits = {r['commit']: r['branch'] for r in branches}
inventory = []
for name in ['source-downloads.jsonl', 'source-downloads-branches.jsonl',
             'source-downloads-wemake-supplement.json', 'source-download-l2df-converter.json']:
    if name.endswith('.jsonl'):
        items = [json.loads(line) for line in (STUDY / name).read_text().splitlines()]
    else:
        items = read(name)
        if isinstance(items, dict):
            items = [items]
    for item in items:
        assert not item.get('error'), item
        folder = item['repo'].replace('/', '__')
        if item['commit'] != default_commits[item['repo']]:
            folder += '__' + extra_commits[item['commit']]
        relative = 'sources/' + folder + '/' + item['path']
        raw = (STUDY / relative).read_bytes()
        assert len(raw) == item['bytes'], relative
        assert digest(raw) == item['sha256'], relative
        blob = hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest()
        assert blob == item['gitBlobSHA'], relative
        inventory.append({**item, 'localRelativePath': relative, 'reverified': True})

flf = read('flf-parser-probe.json')
l2df = read('l2df-parser-probe.json')
base = ROOT / 'downloads/NTSD_2.4_2.0a_clean/NTSD 2.4_2.0a'
for case in l2df['cases']:
    for filename, key in [('input.bin', 'input'), ('decrypted.txt', 'decrypted'),
                          ('converted.dat', 'converted')]:
        actual = pin(STUDY / 'probes' / case['name'] / filename)
        assert actual['bytes'] == case[key + 'Bytes']
        assert actual['sha256'] == case[key + 'SHA256']
    if case['inputPath']:
        assert pin(base / case['inputPath'])['sha256'] == case['inputSHA256']

weapon = next(c for c in l2df['cases'] if c['name'] == 'weapon4')
frame48 = next(f for f in weapon['selectedFrames'] if f['1'] == 48)
nested = [f['1'] for _, f in sorted(frame48['frames'].items(), key=lambda x: int(x[0]))]
assert nested == [49, 50, 51, 52, 53, 54, 55, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 70, 71, 72, 399]
assert weapon['parsedFrameCount'] == 43

scripts = {}
for name in ['probe-flf-parser.cjs', 'probe-l2df-parser.py', 'assemble_evidence.py']:
    path = STUDY / name
    scripts[name] = {**pin(path), 'text': path.read_text()}

requests = [json.loads(line) for line in (STUDY / 'requests.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
failures = [r for r in requests if 'error' in r]
local_support = {}
for path in ['docs/FRAME_LOADER.md', 'docs/research/OBJECT_LOADER.md',
             'docs/evidence/object-loader.json', 'AGENTS.md', 'AGENTS_HISTORY_2026-09-12.md']:
    local_support[path] = pin(ROOT / path)

original_cases = []
for corpus in json.loads((ROOT / 'docs/evidence/object-loader.json').read_text())['corpora']:
    for case in corpus.get('cases', []):
        if case.get('path') in ['chars\\naruto.dat', 'chars\\sasuke.dat', 'chars\\weapon4.dat']:
            original_cases.append({'corpus': corpus['corpus'], **case})
frame_markers = {}
for name in ['naruto', 'sasuke', 'weapon4']:
    raw = (STUDY / 'probes' / name / 'decrypted.txt').read_bytes()
    counts = Counter(re.findall(rb'<frame>\s+(-?\d+)', raw))
    frame_markers[name] = {'markers': sum(counts.values()), 'uniqueIDs': len(counts),
                           'duplicateIDs': {k.decode(): v for k, v in counts.items() if v > 1}}

result = {
    'schemaVersion': 1,
    'title': 'Открытые реализации Little Fighter 2 для нативного NTSD',
    'asOfDate': '2026-09-12',
    'assembledAtUTC': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'researchQuestion': packet['researchQuestion'],
    'scope': packet['scope'],
    'report': {'path': str(REPORT.relative_to(ROOT)), **pin(REPORT)},
    'baselineExeSHA256': '3f7ac67c5890ef979ee24a6dae5528056e7f631725c292cf9cb0a928ebeff71c',
    'studyRelativePath': 'build/research/lf2-open-source-20260912',
    'storage': packet['environment'],
    'preservedWorkingFiles': protected,
    'concurrentWorkingTreeChanges': {
        'files': concurrent_changes,
        'interpretation': 'These files changed during research outside this study edits. They were not restored or edited by this study; initial and current hashes retained.',
        'firstAuditFailure': read('assembly-first-audit-failure.json')
    },
    'repositories': repositories,
    'additionalBranches': branches,
    'licenseClarifications': {
        'atom-tm/l2df-engine': 'Read LICENSE: MIT; separate third-party licenses. API NOASSERTION is not the controlling text.',
        'Archer-Dante/Neora': 'README declares CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; NonCommercial restriction.',
        'fishfolk/punchy': 'Code MIT or Apache-2.0; media licenses separate.',
        'missingLicense': 'No permission to reuse inferred from public source availability.',
        'assets': 'Engine code licenses do not establish rights to original LF2 or NTSD content.'
    },
    'discovery': {
        'githubQueries': ['"little fighter" in:name,description,readme -topic:awesome',
                          'lf2 engine in:name,description', 'littlefighter in:name,description'],
        'scope': 'Bounded search, primary author pages and related branches/forks; not an exhaustive census.',
        'repositoryMetadataCount': len(repositories),
        'repositoriesWithSelectedSourceFiles': len(set(i['repo'] for i in inventory)),
        'additionalLead': {'name': 'A-Engine', 'publisher': 'A-Man',
                           'url': 'https://lf-empire.de/forum/showthread.php?tid=9230',
                           'finding': 'Author describes a C++ SDL/OpenGL engine with its own script format. Public source revision and license not verified.'},
        'originalFAQ': {'publisher': 'Little Fighter 2', 'url': 'https://www.lf2.net/faq_en.html'},
        'lovePlatform': {'publisher': 'LÖVE', 'url': 'https://github.com/love2d/love'}
    },
    'sourceInventory': inventory,
    'sourceVerification': {
        'downloadRecords': len(inventory),
        'uniqueRepositoryCommitPaths': len(set((i['repo'], i['commit'], i['path']) for i in inventory)),
        'bytesAcrossDownloadRecords': sum(i['bytes'] for i in inventory),
        'gitBlobSHA1AndSHA256Reverified': True,
        'completeSourceAudit': False
    },
    'diagnostics': {'flf': flf, 'l2df': l2df},
    'compatibilityFindings': [
        {'candidate': 'Project-F/F.LF', 'case': 'duplicate-frame',
         'evidenceType': 'Executed candidate converter versus retained documented original contract; no new original run.',
         'outcome': 'Mismatch: second frame replaces first and omits wait=3 and next=0.'},
        {'candidate': 'atom-tm/l2df-engine', 'case': 'weapon4',
         'evidenceType': 'Executed candidate decrypt/convert/LFFS2 parse on original DAT; comparison to retained original Object-loader result.',
         'outcome': 'Mismatch: 43 top-level entries, compared with 58 definitions in retained original observation.',
         'textualFrameMarkers': 59, 'topLevelCandidateFrames': 43,
         'retainedOriginalDefinitions': 58, 'retainedOriginalAbsentFrame': 49,
         'candidateFrame48NestedFrames': nested},
        {'candidate': 'atom-tm/l2df-engine', 'case': 'duplicate-frame',
         'evidenceType': 'Executed converter/parser yields separate entries; final replacement inferred statically from Frames:add.',
         'outcome': 'Compatibility risk; complete Frames component/game execution not performed.'},
        {'candidate': 'atom-tm/l2df-engine', 'case': 'naruto/sasuke',
         'evidenceType': 'Executed candidate decrypt/convert/parse.',
         'outcome': 'Parsed 318/268 top-level entries. This is not whole-field or gameplay compatibility acceptance.'}
    ],
    'retainedReferenceDocuments': local_support,
    'retainedOriginalObjectCases': original_cases,
    'decryptedTextFrameMarkerCounts': frame_markers,
    'diagnosticScripts': scripts,
    'retainedSetupAndRetrievalFailures': {
        'recordedRetrievalErrors': failures,
        'lupaLuaJITImportAttempt': (STUDY / 'lupa-runtime-setup.log').read_text(),
        'availableLuaRuntimes': (STUDY / 'lupa-runtime-inventory.log').read_text(),
        'auxiliaryTextInspectionError': read('text-inspection-error.json'),
        'interpretation': 'Retrieval transport errors and unavailable LuaJIT module are setup failures, not source game memory faults. Successful diagnostics explicitly use Lua 5.1.'
    },
    'recommendation': {
        'firstCandidate': 'atom-tm/l2df-engine at a20a16f2e8c9e889e33b3d762c94dc49498d0f83',
        'decision': 'Bounded native feasibility prototype; no immediate NTSDCore replacement.',
        'proposedTimeBudget': '1-2 engineering days; planning cap, not measured port duration.',
        'gates': ['Native macOS window/input/audio and runtime dependency check',
                  'Unchanged NTSD DAT inputs with retained parser contracts',
                  'Existing reference scenarios for movement/combat/RNG',
                  'Measured adaptation surface and remaining-cost comparison']
    },
    'acceptance': {
        'researchReportComplete': True,
        'engineAdopted': False, 'gameRulesChanged': False,
        'baselineAssetsChanged': False, 'originalExecuted': False,
        'newNativeComparison': False, 'candidateGameStarted': False,
        'upstreamFullTestSuiteRun': False, 'macOSAppVerified': False,
        'windowInputAudioVerified': False, 'windowsVerified': False,
        'cleanMacVerified': False, 'wholeGameCompatibility': False,
        'independentReview': False,
        'review': 'Author self-review and artifact/hash verification only; independent review gap retained.',
        'existingBlockedDependenciesResolved': False
    }
}
assert len(repositories) == 13
assert len(inventory) == 1008
assert result['sourceVerification']['bytesAcrossDownloadRecords'] == 5434285
OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'output': str(OUTPUT.relative_to(ROOT)), 'outputBytes': OUTPUT.stat().st_size,
                  'protectedFilesUnchanged': sum(p['unchanged'] for p in protected),
                  'concurrentWorkingFilesChanged': len(concurrent_changes),
                  'sourceVerification': result['sourceVerification'],
                  'repositoryMetadataCount': len(repositories),
                  'recordedRetrievalFailures': len(failures)}, ensure_ascii=False))
